title: Baobab Counterparty Roles and Organisation Resolution Candidates (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-13)
description:
Definition library for the generalisation of ADR-BCP-016's bounded BUYER_ORGANISATION and SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION kinds into Organisation plus tenant-scoped CounterpartyRole (ADR-BCP-018 sections 11 and 112, ADR-BCP-014 sections 10-17), and for the quarantine of possible duplicate Organisations (ADR-BCP-018 sections 99-101, ADR-BCP-023 sections 50-52).
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/CounterpartyRole), not the document root.

Invariants:
  CounterpartyRole is tenant-scoped commercial capacity, never identity and never authorization (ADR-BCP-014 sections 11-17).
  A migrated BUYER_ORGANISATION or SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION keeps its canonical id; the role records the legacy kind it came from.
  Duplicate candidates are found on governed identifiers only, never on names, and are quarantined for review.
  A reviewer decision records whether two Organisations are the same real organisation. It merges nothing: a canonical merge is a controlled change under ADR-BCP-021 (ADR-BCP-023 section 52).

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

counterpartyRoleId.description: Opaque Control Plane-minted CounterpartyRole identifier. Must not embed organisation names, tenants, roles or brands.

counterpartyRoleType.description: Commercial capacity an Organisation acts in for a tenant (ADR-BCP-014 section 13; THIRD_PARTY_LOGISTICS is that section's 3PL). Roles are not organisation forms and not relationships. Extensible by a versioned contract change.

counterpartyRoleStatus.description: Role lifecycle. An ENDED role stays queryable as history.

legacyOrganisationKind.description: The ADR-BCP-016 bounded kind a migrated role was materialised from (ADR-BCP-018 section 112).

CounterpartyRole.description: An Organisation's effective-dated commercial role for one tenant. At most one live (PENDING, ACTIVE or SUSPENDED) role per organisation, tenant and role type. A role grants no tenant access and no portal access (ADR-BCP-014 section 17).

source_authority.description: Who established the role, e.g. legacy-canonical-entity for an ORG-13 migration or the admitting reviewer's authority.

resolutionCandidateStatus.description: OPEN: quarantined, awaiting review. DISTINCT: a reviewer found two different real organisations. DUPLICATE_CONFIRMED: a reviewer found the same real organisation; the merge itself is a separate ADR-BCP-021 controlled change.

matchedIdentifier.description: A governed identifier both Organisations carry. The value is normalised (case and separators removed) exactly as identity resolution compares it.

normalised_value.description: The identifier value with whitespace, '.', '/' and '-' removed and letters upper-cased, exactly as identity resolution compares it.

ResolutionCandidateDecision.description: A reviewer's decision on a quarantined candidate. The reviewer is the authenticated principal, never a request field.

surviving_organisation_id.description: Required for DUPLICATE_CONFIRMED: the Organisation a later ADR-BCP-021 merge would keep. Must be one of the candidate's organisations.

OrganisationResolutionCandidate.description: A quarantined pair of Organisations that share at least one governed identifier. One candidate per unordered pair. A DISTINCT pair is reopened only when a governed identifier match it was not decided on appears.

source.description: What detected the candidate, e.g. organisation-reconciliation.

decided_by.description: Authenticated identity of the reviewer, stamped by the Control Plane from the request's credentials.

CounterpartyRoleAssignRequest.description: Assigns a tenant-scoped counterparty role to a canonical Organisation (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-13). The tenant comes from the path and the source authority from the Control Plane, never the body. Repeating a live assignment returns the stored role.

status.description: The new role's status; ACTIVE when omitted. A new role is never ENDED.

CounterpartyRoleEndRequest.description: Ends a counterparty role. The role stays queryable as history.

reason.description: Why, recorded in the audit trail.

CounterpartyReconciliationReport.description: The outcome of one ORG-13 reconciliation run: legacy buyer and supplier records migrated, what could not be migrated and why, and the duplicate-organisation candidates refreshed. A run merges nothing and is safe to repeat.

backlog.description: Legacy records still awaiting migration, counted by the reason they could not be migrated.
